svg.title: The school counseling gap in Korea
svg.desc: Left: 76.8% of Korean schools had a Wee Class counseling room in 2024; 23.2% had none. Right: only 42.5% of schools had a full-time professional school counselor in April 2025; 57.5% had none.
svg.text: Each square = 1% of Korean schools (about 12,100 schools in total).
